items: 𝙁𝙡𝙚𝙭𝙞𝙗𝙡𝙚 𝙈𝙤𝙙𝙪𝙡𝙖𝙧 𝘿𝙚𝙨𝙞𝙜𝙣-This 108" L-shaped modular sofa comes with 2 independent modules that allow free combination into L-shape, straight sofa or casual sofa bed to fit your living room layout and daily needs. The flexible configuration adapts to small apartments, open spaces and rental homes, making it a versatile furniture choice for changing scenes and room sizes.

𝘾𝙡𝙤𝙪𝙙-𝙇𝙞𝙠𝙚 𝘾𝙤𝙢𝙛𝙤𝙧𝙩 -Upholstered in high-quality soft corduroy fabric, this boneless cloud couch delivers ultra-cozy touching and breathability for year-round use. Featuring deep oversized seating and a spacious left-facing chaise, it is filled with high-resilience foam that offers perfect support without sagging, wrapping you in comfort for lounging, napping or family leisure time.

𝙉𝙤 𝘼𝙨𝙨𝙚𝙢𝙗𝙡𝙮 𝙍𝙚𝙦𝙪𝙞𝙧𝙚𝙙 -Arriving in two boxes with vacuum compression packaging, this sectional sofa requires 0 tools and 0 assembly – simply unbox, wait 24–72 hours for full rebound, and gently pat the cushions to speed up fluffing. The lightweight modular design is easy to move through narrow doorways and hallways, ideal for apartments, rentals and first-time homeowners.

𝙋𝙧𝙖𝙘𝙩𝙞𝙘𝙖𝙡 𝘿𝙚𝙩𝙖𝙞𝙡𝙨 𝙛𝙤𝙧 𝙁𝙖𝙢𝙞𝙡𝙮 & 𝙋𝙚𝙩-𝙁𝙧𝙞𝙚𝙣𝙙𝙡𝙮 𝙐𝙨𝙚-Designed for daily family life, the durable corduroy surface resists wear and scratches, while pet hair can be easily cleaned with a lint roller. Built-in side pockets keep remotes, phones and magazines within reach, and the sturdy structure maintains its shape even with frequent use by kids and adults, combining stylish look with long-lasting practicality.
